description: One coin's dashboard: price, 24h/7d/30d change, market cap and rank, fully diluted value, volume, circulating/total/max supply, all-time high, the exchanges and DEX pools it trades on, its contracts, the Animal Spirits meter, the buzz meter (how much it is talked about against its own normal day), buzz against price, the Outlook Race simulated price range for 1 month to 5 years, its Team Dump Radar light and its related coins. A coin we can name but have not built yet starts building and answers status=building (call again in a minute). No key. From EventTrader's crypto dashboards (cymetica.com/crypto). Every number carries its source and time; a number that failed a plausibility check is withheld, never guessed. Places no orders, moves no funds. Not financial advice.
